description: This file defines an abstract class 'CosmosOptions' and related interfaces and classes for configuring and executing operations against Azure Cosmos DB within the Orleans framework. It includes namespace conditional compilation, properties for Cosmos DB configuration, methods for client setup, and a default executor implementation with retry logic.

classes.name: CosmosOptions
classes.description: Abstract class providing configuration options for Azure Cosmos DB storage within Orleans, including client setup and resource management settings.

classes.name: ICosmosOperationExecutor
classes.description: Interface defining a method for executing Cosmos DB operations with retry logic.

classes.name: DefaultCosmosOperationExecutor
classes.description: Singleton implementation of ICosmosOperationExecutor with retry logic for handling rate limiting (429) responses from Cosmos DB.

methods.name: ConfigureCosmosClient
methods.description: Overloaded methods to configure the Cosmos DB client using connection string, endpoint with credentials, or a delegate.

methods.name: ExecuteOperation
methods.description: Method to execute a Cosmos DB operation with automatic retry on rate limiting, implemented in DefaultCosmosOperationExecutor.
